attempts.summary: Installed and ran a 3-member etcd 3.4.30 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Ubuntu 24.04, apt package etcd-server/etcd-client), wrote application keys under /app/*, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, deleted its data dir), removed the dead member from the cluster via etcdctl member remove, added a fresh member for node3 via etcdctl member add with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, and started a clean etcd instance on node3 that joined the existing cluster. Verified 3/3 healthy members, quorum, and all original application keys intact and readable from the new node3 member. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot_id and full cluster/quorum/data recovery after each restart.
